import subprocess,json,datetime
command=['/usr/local/bin/docker', '--context', 'colima-sail-gate', 'run', '--rm', '--name', 'sail-sem-wcc-input-bootstrap', '--read-only', '--network', 'none', '--memory', '256m', '--memory-swap', '256m', '--cpus', '1', '--pids-limit', '32', '--mount', 'type=volume,source=sail-extension-targets,target=/targets', '--mount', 'type=bind,source=/Users/alexy/src/sail-extensions-gates/stream-experiments-20260930/sem-wcc-pilot-inputs,target=/seed,readonly', '--entrypoint', '/targets/graph-nuts-ffcfbd569/venv/bin/python', 'sha256:f3518d652fbea8b9b9f9ebf9849277ca3bd39d0c21bb2c6e36fbaeaa2dc2678e', '-I', '-B', '-c', "from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,sys
files=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);dest=Path('/targets/sail-stream-experiments-20260930/sem-wcc-pilot-inputs')
def sha(p):
 with p.open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()

for f in files:assert sha(Path('/seed')/f['name'])==f['sha256']
dest.mkdir()
records=[]
for f in files:
 target=dest/f['name'];shutil.copyfile(Path('/seed')/f['name'],target)
 assert sha(target)==f['sha256'];target.chmod(0o444)
 records.append({'path':str(target),'sha256':sha(target),'bytes':target.stat().st_size})
print(json.dumps({'outcome':'copied_and_verified','files':records,'volume_free_bytes':shutil.disk_usage('/targets').free}))
